metadata.question: Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?" I need to: 1. Define geometry for Thailand. 2. Choose a fire activity dataset - MODIS active fire products (MCD14A1 or MOD14A1) or VIIRS (but VIIRS starts later, so MODIS is better for 2008). 3. Time periods: February 2008 (2008-02-01 to 2008-02-29) and August 2008 (2008-08-01 to 2008-08-31). 4. Count fire pixels/detections in each period. 5. Compare counts. 6. Handle cases where collections might be empty or have no valid pixels. Data considerations: - Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire products: MOD14A1 (Terra) or MYD14A1 (Aqua). But MCD14A1 (combined) might be better. - Actually, MOD14A1 collection (Terra) is available from 2000-02-18. - I'll use "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" (Terra daily thermal anomalies/fire) or "MODIS/006/MYD14A1" (Aqua). - However, for fire counts, I need to use the FireMask band (or similar). In MOD14A1, there's a 'FireMask' band with values: 0=not processed, 1-3=cloud/water, 4=non-fire, 5-7=fire (low confidence to high confidence), 8=missing, 9=sea. - I'll count pixels with FireMask >= 5 (fire pixels). Alternatively, use the FIRMS dataset (MODIS C6) which is specifically for active fires. Actually, let me check available collections: 1. "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" - Terra MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire Daily 1km 2. "MODIS/006/MYD14A1" - Aqua MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire Daily 1km 3. "FIRMS" - MODIS Active Fires (this is a feature collection, not image collection) Better to use MOD14A1 or MYD14A1 image collections and count fire pixels. I'll use MOD14A1 (Terra) as it has longer history. Plan: 1. Define Thailand boundary (use LSIB or simplified country boundary). 2. Filter MOD14A1 for February 2008 and August 2008. 3. For each month, select the 'FireMask' band. 4. Count pixels where FireMask >= 5 (fire pixels). 5. Compare counts. Need to handle: - Check if collections are empty (C1). - After masking (though we're not masking clouds for fire detection, just selecting fire pixels), check if valid fire pixels exist (C2). - Ensure calculations are valid (C3). Let me structure the code: 1. Geometry: Use FAO country boundaries or simplified LSIB. 2. Data: MOD14A1 collection filtered by date. 3. Process: For each month, map over images to count fire pixels, then sum. 4. Validation: Check collection sizes, pixel counts. 5. Output: Print counts, then A/B/C/D. I'll use scale=1000 for reduceRegion to avoid timeout. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Thailand geometry using LSIB simplified var thailand = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_co', 'TH')); // Simplify geometry to avoid computation issues var thailandGeom = thailand.geometry().simplify(1000); // 2. Define time periods var febStart = '2008-02-01'; var febEnd = '2008-02-29'; var augStart = '2008-08-01'; var augEnd = '2008-08-31'; // 3. Get MODIS Terra fire data (MOD14A1) var febCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(febStart, febEnd) .filterBounds(thailandGeom); var augCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(augStart, augEnd) .filterBounds(thailandGeom); // 4. Check collection sizes var febSize = febCollection.size().getInfo(); var augSize = augCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('February 2008 Images:', febSize); console.log('August 2008 Images:', augSize); // Case C1: Empty collection if (febSize === 0 || augSize === 0) { // Try Aqua MODIS as fallback console.log('Trying Aqua MODIS as fallback...'); var febCollectionAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') .filterDate(febStart, febEnd) .filterBounds(thailandGeom); var augCollectionAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') .filterDate(augStart, augEnd) .filterBounds(thailandGeom); febSize = febCollectionAqua.size().getInfo(); augSize = augCollectionAqua.size().getInfo(); console.log('Aqua February 2008 Images:', febSize); console.log('Aqua August 2008 Images:', augSize); if (febSize === 0 || augSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Use Aqua collections febCollection = febCollectionAqua; augCollection = augCollectionAqua; } // 5. Function to count fire pixels in an image function countFirePixels(img) { // FireMask: 0=not processed, 1-3=cloud/water, 4=non-fire, 5-7=fire, 8=missing, 9=sea var fireMask = img.select('FireMask'); // Create binary fire mask (5,6,7 = fire) var fireBinary = fireMask.gte(5).and(fireMask.lte(7)); // Count fire pixels var count = fireBinary.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: thailandGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('FireMask'); return ee.Image.constant(count).rename('fireCount'); } // 6. Compute total fire counts for each month var febFireCountImg = febCollection.map(countFirePixels).sum(); var augFireCountImg = augCollection.map(countFirePixels).sum(); var febFireCount = febFireCountImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: thailandGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('fireCount').getInfo(); var augFireCount = augFireCountImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: thailandGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('fireCount').getInfo(); console.log('February 2008 Fire Pixel Count:', febFireCount); console.log('August 2008 Fire Pixel Count:', augFireCount); // 7. Validation checks // Case C2: No valid fire pixels if ((febFireCount === 0 && augFireCount === 0) || (febFireCount === null && augFireCount === null)) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Case C3: Calculation failure if (febFireCount === null || augFireCount === null || isNaN(febFireCount) || isNaN(augFireCount) || febFireCount === undefined || augFireCount === undefined) { console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Compare and output result console.log('Comparison: August > February?', augFireCount > febFireCount); if (augFireCount > febFireCount) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
